column3: Saori Route ・ Success Story
...It's not that I don't understand what you're saying, but...
It may be rude, but your speech is really lacking persuasive power.
Guh...
Can I say something that can recover from this?
Ah... Hm... Err...
Well, anyway...
I know that what I said was incoherent.
But, I would like you to listen. If there's even a small chance, I would still want to try.
Kyousuke-shi...
...If that's the case, Kyousuke-shi.
Please explain further about Kiririn-shi's friend, Ayase-shi.
...Okay.
If it's about my Lovely Angel Ayase, then leave it to me.
...So, I properly explained the on-goings between Kirino and Ayase.
Basically, the incident where Ayase found out about Kirino being an otaku.
And that Ayase wanted to break off contact with Kirino.
Ayase, unlike Kirino, was a normal middle school girl.
She probably can't view otakus who lust after girl figures and immerse themselves in little girl anime as anything but gross.
Furthermore, Ayase's disgust for otakus is at an incomparably high level.
This is understandable, as her mother is working as a PTA leader, who regularly launches meetings to discuss regulations against games and anime.
Receiving the full blast of TV commentators and stubborn journalists blaming otakus, it's no wonder Ayase doesn't just have a simple opinion.
Ayase's disgust is especially fueled by the event known as the "Siscaly Incident".
In that event, a male electrocuted a female to death in an attempt to imitate Siscaly after getting influenced by it.
However, the truth was that the incident was being used by the media to put blame on otakus.
Of course, I don't mean that otakus are completely innocent.
However, the argument that otakus are a negative influence on society is not necessarily correct.
By explaining the misunderstanding, after a few twists and turns, Ayase's friendship with Kirino returned to normal.
I see, I see...
That's why you could just explain things to your fiance.
If you put it that way...
Somehow I feel confident that I can persuade him!
That's right! You can do it! If you think you can do it, you can!!
Go for it, go for it! If it's you, then you can do it! So do it! Never give up!!
Kyousuke-shi, you're like a parody of the Fire Fairy MAD video.
I, too, feel like I'm just blindly cheering.
However, it's good enough that Saori's smiling again.
It's just as you say.
If you give up before you start, then you'll never get what you want.
Yup, that's the spirit!
Actually, I'm supposed to meet him tomorrow...
I think I'll properly talk about it then.
